marks.gloss_en: נקוט דרב ביבי בידך, דשמואל הוא דחייש ליחידאה -- Rav Beivai's version, in which Shmuel rules as the individual R' Mona, fits Shmuel's known concern for an individual's view
דתנן: ... משום רבי יהודה בן בתירה אמרו ... ואמר שמואל: הלכה כרבי יהודה בן בתירה -- Shmuel rules as a view the mishna reports in one tanna's name
Rav Yosef: hold Rav Beivai's version in your hand
מיתיבי: היו בה אותיות מטושטשות או מקורעות ... ואם לאו פסולה -- missing letters disqualify, so how can omitted letters or verses be valid?
לא קשיא: הא בכולה, הא במקצתה (= p_okimta_bechula, p_okimta_bemiktzata)
if the Megilla has blurred or torn letters: if their trace is visible it is kosher, and if not it is pasul
one who read it with its order transposed has not fulfilled his obligation
(entertained) 'long enough to finish all of it' is measured from where he stands to the end
the halakha is not as R' Mona
Shmuel: the halakha is as R' Yehuda ben Beteira
if the scribe omitted letters or verses and the reader read them as a meturgeman translates, he has fulfilled his obligation
a reader who omitted one verse may not read the whole and then that verse, but reads from that verse onward
(entertained) the case is one who says each verse and then writes it
Rav Ashi: dozing is asleep and not asleep, awake and not awake -- when called he answers, he cannot return a reasoned reply, and when reminded he remembers
sam [of the mishnah] is samma
לימא מסייע ליה: the mishnah's case needs a Megilla lying before him -- so writing must be from a text
דלמא דאתרמי ליה אתרמויי -- perhaps it merely happened so
the stam's second case: a [complete] Megilla lies before him, he reads from it verse by verse and writes
מדקאמר כל התורה כולה ראויה שתיכתב על פיך -- מכלל דמיושרין הן אצלו
מכלל דמיושרין הן אצלו -- והא רבי מאיר כתב? (one with mastery is forbidden, yet R' Meir with mastery wrote)
שעת הדחק שאני (= p_shaat_hadchak_shani)
Rav Chisda found Rav Chananel writing books not from a written text
כמאן? כי האי תנא, דתניא: ר' ירמיה אומר משום רבינו: תפלין ומזוזות נכתבות שלא מן הכתב
Abaye permitted the house of bar Chavu to write tefillin and mezuzot not from a written text
ומי יצא? והאמר רב ... צריכה שתהא כתובה כולה -- a Megilla written verse by verse as he reads is not yet written entire (והאמר: amoraic-memra contradiction, kind svara under protest, §12)
Rav: the halakha follows the one who says [the Megilla is read] in its entirety
מיתיבי: R' Meir wrote a Megilla from his heart and read from it
R' Shimon ben Elazar: R' Meir went to intercalate the year in Asia; there was no Megilla there, and he wrote it from his heart and read it
שאני רבי מאיר דמיקיים ביה ועפעפיך יישירו נגדך (= p_abbahu_shani_rmeir)
R' Abbahu: R' Meir is different, for in him is fulfilled 'and let your eyelids look straight before you' (Prov 4:25)
והלכתא: תפלין אין צריכין שרטוט
מזוזות צריכין שרטוט -- for mezuzot, against the baraita at 18b.16
אידי ואידי נכתבות שלא מן הכתב
the ruling: tefillin do not require scoring
